$comment: VS Code custom-data for htmx 2.x, loaded by vscode-html-language-server via initializationOptions.dataPaths (see lsp/html.lua). Makes hx-* complete inside a tag with hover docs, instead of being snippets to memorise.

globalAttributes.name: hx-get
globalAttributes.description:
Issues a GET to the given URL and swaps the HTML response into the DOM.

The request is triggered by the element's natural event (click for most elements, change for inputs, submit for forms) unless `hx-trigger` says otherwise.

```html
<button hx-get="/items" hx-target="#list">Load</button>
```

globalAttributes.name: hx-post
globalAttributes.description:
Issues a POST to the given URL and swaps the HTML response into the DOM.

```html
<form hx-post="/items" hx-target="#list" hx-swap="beforeend">
```

globalAttributes.name: hx-put
globalAttributes.description: Issues a PUT to the given URL and swaps the HTML response into the DOM.

globalAttributes.name: hx-patch
globalAttributes.description: Issues a PATCH to the given URL and swaps the HTML response into the DOM.

globalAttributes.name: hx-delete
globalAttributes.description:
Issues a DELETE to the given URL and swaps the HTML response into the DOM.

Returning an empty body with `hx-swap="outerHTML"` is the usual way to remove the row that was deleted.

globalAttributes.name: hx-target
globalAttributes.description: Which element the response is swapped into. Defaults to the element that made the request.

globalAttributes.name: hx-swap
globalAttributes.description:
How the response is swapped in relative to the target. Defaults to `innerHTML`.

Modifiers append to the value: `swap:200ms`, `settle:1s`, `scroll:top`, `show:bottom`, `transition:true`, `ignoreTitle:true`, `focus-scroll:true`.

globalAttributes.name: hx-swap-oob
globalAttributes.description:
Marks an element **in the response** as an out-of-band swap: htmx pulls it out and swaps it against the element with the same `id` already in the DOM, independently of `hx-target`.

Value is `true` (outerHTML) or any `hx-swap` value, optionally `strategy:selector`.

The usual way to update a cart badge from a response that is otherwise about the cart list.

globalAttributes.name: hx-trigger
globalAttributes.description:
Which event fires the request, replacing the element's default.

Comma-separated for several. Modifiers: `once`, `changed`, `delay:1s`, `throttle:500ms`, `from:<selector>`, `target:<selector>`, `consume`, `queue:first|last|all|none`.

```html
<input hx-get="/search" hx-trigger="keyup changed delay:300ms">
<div hx-get="/feed" hx-trigger="every 2s">
<div hx-get="/more" hx-trigger="revealed">
```

Special events: `load`, `revealed`, `intersect`, `every <t>`.

globalAttributes.name: hx-vals
globalAttributes.description:
Extra values to submit with the request, as a JSON object. Prefix with `js:` to evaluate an expression instead.

```html
<div hx-post="/x" hx-vals='{"id": 42}'>
```

In a Go template, mind the quoting: `hx-vals='{"id": {{ .ID }}}'`.

globalAttributes.name: hx-params
globalAttributes.description: Filters which parameters are submitted: `*`, `none`, `not <list>`, or a comma-separated list of names.

globalAttributes.name: hx-include
globalAttributes.description:
A CSS selector for additional elements whose values are included in the request — the way to submit inputs that live outside the element being triggered.

Accepts the extended syntax: `closest`, `find`, `next`, `previous`, `this`.

globalAttributes.name: hx-headers
globalAttributes.description:
Extra request headers as a JSON object. Prefix with `js:` to evaluate.

```html
<div hx-post="/x" hx-headers='{"X-CSRF-Token": "{{ .CSRF }}"}'>
```

globalAttributes.name: hx-select
globalAttributes.description: A CSS selector picking the part of the response to swap in, discarding the rest. Lets a handler return a whole page and the client take one fragment.

globalAttributes.name: hx-select-oob
globalAttributes.description: Comma-separated selectors picking pieces of the response to swap out-of-band, for responses you do not control the markup of.

globalAttributes.name: hx-boost
globalAttributes.description:
Turns descendant `<a>` and `<form>` into AJAX requests that replace `<body>` and push history, degrading to normal navigation without JS.

Usually set once on `<body>`.

globalAttributes.name: hx-push-url
globalAttributes.description: Pushes the request URL into browser history so the result is bookmarkable and Back works. `true`, `false`, or a URL.

globalAttributes.name: hx-replace-url
globalAttributes.description: Replaces the current history entry instead of pushing a new one. `true`, `false`, or a URL.

globalAttributes.name: hx-indicator
globalAttributes.description: A CSS selector for the element that gets the `htmx-request` class while the request is in flight. Defaults to the requesting element.

globalAttributes.name: hx-disabled-elt
globalAttributes.description: A CSS selector for elements to set `disabled` on for the duration of the request — the standard double-submit guard. `this` and `closest form` are the common values.

globalAttributes.name: hx-confirm
globalAttributes.description: Shows a `confirm()` dialog with this message before issuing the request.

globalAttributes.name: hx-prompt
globalAttributes.description: Shows a `prompt()` with this message; the answer is sent in the `HX-Prompt` header.

globalAttributes.name: hx-sync
globalAttributes.description:
Coordinates requests between elements: `<selector>:<strategy>` where strategy is `drop`, `abort`, `replace`, or `queue first|last|all`.

```html
<input hx-sync="closest form:abort">
```

globalAttributes.name: hx-on
globalAttributes.description:
Inline handler for an event, as `hx-on:<event>="<js>"`. Namespaced htmx events use double colons: `hx-on::after-request`, `hx-on::before-swap`, `hx-on::config-request`.

Unlike `onclick`, it survives CSP `unsafe-inline` restrictions being the htmx way, and works for htmx's own events.

globalAttributes.name: hx-ext
globalAttributes.description:
Enables htmx extensions on this element and its children, comma-separated. `ignore:<name>` disables one for a subtree.

Common: `sse`, `ws`, `response-targets`, `head-support`, `preload`.

globalAttributes.name: hx-encoding
globalAttributes.description: Changes the request encoding. `multipart/form-data` is the value that matters — required for file uploads.

globalAttributes.name: hx-preserve
globalAttributes.description: Keeps this element as-is across swaps, by `id`. For video players, iframes and anything with state the server cannot reproduce.

globalAttributes.name: hx-disable
globalAttributes.description: Disables all htmx processing for this element and its children. The correct guard around user-generated HTML.

globalAttributes.name: hx-disinherit
globalAttributes.description: Stops named attributes being inherited by children: `*` for all, or a space-separated list such as `hx-target hx-swap`.

globalAttributes.name: hx-inherit
globalAttributes.description: Opts specific attributes back into inheritance when htmx is configured with `disableInheritance: true`.

globalAttributes.name: hx-history
globalAttributes.description: Set to `false` to keep this page out of the history cache in localStorage — for pages showing sensitive data.

globalAttributes.name: hx-history-elt
globalAttributes.description: Marks the element to snapshot and restore for history, instead of `<body>`. Rarely needed.

globalAttributes.name: hx-validate
globalAttributes.description: Forces HTML5 validation before the request, for elements that are not inside a form.

globalAttributes.name: hx-request
globalAttributes.description: Per-request config as a JSON object: `timeout` (ms), `credentials`, `noHeaders`. Prefix with `js:` to evaluate.

values.name: innerHTML
values.description: Replace the target's content. The default.

values.name: outerHTML
values.description: Replace the target element itself.

values.name: textContent
values.description: Replace the target's text content, without parsing the response as HTML.

values.name: beforebegin
values.description: Insert before the target, as a sibling.

values.name: afterbegin
values.description: Insert as the target's first child.

values.name: beforeend
values.description: Insert as the target's last child. The append case.

values.name: afterend
values.description: Insert after the target, as a sibling.

values.name: delete
values.description: Delete the target regardless of the response.

values.name: none
values.description: Do not swap. Out-of-band swaps in the response still apply.

values.name: this
values.description: The element itself. The default behaviour, stated explicitly.

values.name: closest
values.description: Nearest ancestor (or self) matching the selector: `closest tr`.

values.name: find
values.description: First descendant matching the selector: `find .body`.

values.name: next
values.description: Next sibling element; `next <selector>` for the next match in the document.

values.name: previous
values.description: Previous sibling element; `previous <selector>` for the previous match.

values.name: body
values.description: The document body.

values.name: load
values.description: Fires once when the element is loaded into the DOM — lazy loading.

values.name: revealed
values.description: Fires when the element scrolls into the viewport — infinite scroll.

values.name: intersect
values.description: Fires on IntersectionObserver intersection; takes `root:` and `threshold:` modifiers.

values.name: every 2s
values.description: Polling. Any duration: `every 500ms`, `every 1m`.
All parameters. The default.

values.name: none
values.description: No parameters.

values.name: not
values.description: All except the comma-separated list that follows.

values.name: multipart/form-data
values.description: Required for file uploads.

values.name: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
values.description: The default.
